method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 10 of 13 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: Finite Groups with Order a Power of Two
picks.author: John Baez
picks.why_it_matters: About 99% of groups of order up to 2000 have order 1024. Baez sketches why 2-groups dominate: central extensions are classified by quadratic maps over F2.

picks.title: Bickering Buildings: A Dialogue Between the Churches of Athens in 1854
picks.why_it_matters: Anonymous 1854 satire has Athens' churches bicker, showing how the new Greek capital fought over foreign influence, Byzantine heritage and its architectural identity.

picks.title: AI Vs. High-Level Synthesis
picks.author: Brian Bailey
picks.why_it_matters: Argues HLS's real value is faster verification at the abstract level, which makes it a natural base for AI agents exploring designs. Amdahl's law applied to chip design.

picks.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
picks.why_it_matters: Residual connections average away early-layer detail. DeepCrossAttention instead lets each token attend across layer depth, with under 0.2% extra parameters and a retrofit path for pretrained models.

picks.title: A New Age of Sail
picks.author: David A. Graham
picks.why_it_matters: First-person reportage from a stormy Atlantic crossing on a wind-powered cargo ship. It shows whether sail freight can work as a real industry.
